newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN COMPETITION BOARD TO PROBE VIDEO FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN COMPETITION BOARD TO PROBE VIDEO FIRMS.

text.p: South Africa's Competition Board said on Thursday it had launched an investigation into Ster-Kinekor Video and Nu Metro Video's pricing policies and their dealings with video dealer group buying associations.
The investigation had been neccessitated by recent dissent and recriminations between Ster-Kinekor and Nu Metro and video store owners, the board said in a statement.

The board said the investigation had been launched to determine whether Ster-Kinekor and Nu Metro's pricing policies and the two companies' manner of dealing with video dealer group-buying associations and franchise chains constituted a restrictive practice.
It would also investigate whether the six month "window period" during which video film distributors could prohibit their resale was still justifiable.
Ster Kinekor is a subsidiary of Interleisure Ltd and Nu Metro is owned by CNA Gallo Ltd . Both companies are the principal video film distributors in the country.
The latest probe follows an investigation in 1990 which led to certain practices in the video industry being declared unlawful.
Interested parties would be given 30 days to submit written representation on the investigation, the board said.
